account:
It is day 1 at 06:00, and I have just woken at home. I have not yet seen today's activity. I should read my appointment book at the office this morning. The schedule I last read includes 08:00 office, 10:00 grain inspection at the mill, lunch at home, 13:00 council letters, 15:00 tea at the neighbour's east-dock cottage, 16:30 office, and 19:00 home.

The notable business is a preventive maintenance inspection. Yesterday Builder reported no confirmed defects at the bridge, landing, or warehouse. I agreed to two emeralds total for inspection of the town hall doors, bridge decking, and east ferry landing, payable upon written findings; no repairs or extra charges are authorized. Builder did not initially hear my approval, so Secretary relayed it. Secretary came to my home last night and reported his acceptance of the terms and today's 16:30 appointment. I clarified which landing and asked that he use his own writing materials or borrow an available office book without extra expense. This appears to be routine preventive work, not a response to any confirmed danger.

Yesterday Neighbour had no confirmed dock news or cottage problems to report. Neighbour said Freight had been asking about deliveries at the bakery; I also heard Freight offering a ferry crossing. I do not know of any unusual purpose behind that activity. No outstanding bills had been reported in Secretary's office notes.
